私隱政策
資料收集
為了提供更好的應用程式服務，本應用程式要求用戶提供以下資料：
基本資料：年齡、性別
健康與使用數據：應用程式內的運動及功能使用數據、體能活動適應力問卷數據

所有資料收集均以自願為原則，資料僅作為提升用戶體驗之用途。
用戶有權隨時終止提供個人資料及要求刪除已記錄的資料。如有需要，用戶可電郵至本團隊聯絡(lcjlee@polyu.edu.hk)。
個人資料儲存與保密
我們非常重視每位用戶的私隱和安全。所有經「戶外健體樂」應用程式收集得來的用戶資料，將數據加密儲存於受保護的伺服器／數據庫中, 除非獲得用戶明確許可及／或在法律法規要求的情況下，所有經本應用程式收集的個人資料絕不會向第三方共享資料。
任何由用戶傳送或登載於本應用程式的意見、建議或非個人身份反饋，均將以非保密及非專利的形式自願提供予本團隊，團隊保留使用或分析該等資料以作優化服務之權利。
本應用程式的瀏覽紀錄
在不收集任何個人身份識別資料下，系統會記錄使用或瀏覽本應用程式的數據，以編制統計報告和分析與流動裝置相關的問題，以助本團隊改善本應用程式及作為學術研究用途。
人工智能助理（AI Chatbot）之使用與數據私隱保障
本應用程式內置「人工智能助理」（AI Chatbot）功能，旨在為用戶提供即時的互動支援，包括：根據用戶提出的肌骼狀況或痛症情況，建議用戶合適使用的戶外健身器材；為確保用戶的私隱安全，本團隊在此功能上實施以下嚴格的私隱保護措施：
不主動索取個人資料：AI 助理只會使用閣下在此對話中即時提供的文字內容來回答問題，絕不會主動索取閣下的真實姓名、電話號碼、住址或詳細身份證明等個人隱私資料。
對話紀錄之用途與保密：系統可能會保留用戶與 AI 助理的去識別化對話紀錄，僅用於分析回覆準確度，優化系統服務品質。
用戶查閱個人資料的權利
根據香港法例第 486 章《個人資料（私隱）條例》，作為資料當事人，用戶有權：
查詢本團隊是否持有用戶的個人資料及查閱該等資料；
要求更正任何有關用戶的不準確資料；
查明本團隊對個人資料的政策、處理方法以及持有的資料種類；及
要求停止使用或撤回用戶的個人資料。
如用戶想查閱或更正本團隊所持有關於用戶的資料，用戶可直接聯絡執行評估的本團隊人員(lcjlee@polyu.edu.hk)提出申請。我們將根據《個人資料（私隱）條例》作出相應的處理與跟進。
用戶同意私隱政策聲明
當用戶下載、註冊或瀏覽本「戶外健體樂」應用程式時，即表示用戶已詳細閱讀、理解並同意本「私隱政策聲明」的所有條款及細則。如用戶未能接受本政策之內容，應立即停止使用本應用程式。
修訂私隱政策內容
本「私隱政策聲明」將視乎系統研發進展或法規要求不時修訂。用戶可隨時在應用程式內查閱最新版本。如對本政策或資料處理有任何疑問，請於參與活動前向本計劃團隊查詢。
English Version
Privacy Policy
Data Collection
To provide enhanced application services, this Application requests users to provide the following information:
Basic Information: Age and gender
Health and Usage Data: Exercise and feature usage data within the Application, as well as Physical Activity Readiness Questionnaire (PAR-Q) data
All data collection is conducted on a voluntary basis, and the data collected will solely be used to improve user experience.
Users reserve the right to cease providing personal data and request the deletion of recorded data at any time. If necessary, users may contact our team via email at lcjlee@polyu.edu.hk.
Storage and Confidentiality of Personal Data

We attach great importance to the privacy and security of every user. All user data collected through the "OutdoorFit" Application will be encrypted and stored in protected servers/databases. Unless explicit consent is obtained from the user and/or where required by statutory laws and regulations, no personal data collected by this Application will be shared with any third parties.

Any comments, suggestions, or non-personally identifiable feedback transmitted or posted by users on this Application are provided voluntarily to our team on a non-confidential and non-proprietary basis. The team reserves the right to utilize or analyze such information for service optimization.
Application Browsing and Usage Logs

Without collecting any personally identifiable information, the system logs data concerning the use and browsing of this Application to compile statistical reports and diagnose mobile device-related issues, thereby assisting our team in improving the Application and facilitating academic research.
Use of AI Chatbot and Data Privacy Protection

This Application features a built-in "AI Chatbot" designed to provide real-time interactive support to users, including recommending suitable outdoor fitness equipment based on user-reported musculoskeletal conditions or pain. To safeguard user privacy, our team implements the following rigorous protection measures within this feature:

No Unsolicited Requests for Personal Data: The AI assistant will only utilize the textual content provided directly by you within the conversation to respond to inquiries. It will never proactively solicit personal identifying details, such as your real name, phone number, residential address, or detailed identity proof.

Confidentiality and Purpose of Conversation Logs: The system may retain de-identified conversation logs between users and the AI assistant solely for analyzing response accuracy and optimizing service quality.
Users' Rights to Access Personal Data
Pursuant to the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance (Cap. 486), as a data subject, you are entitled to:
Inquire whether our team holds your personal data and request access to such data;
Request the correction of any inaccurate personal data relating to you;
Ascertain our policies and practices in relation to personal data and be informed of the categories of personal data held by us; and
Request the cessation of use or withdrawal of your personal data.

If you wish to access or correct your personal data held by our team, you may submit a request directly to our team at lcjlee@polyu.edu.hk. We will process and follow up on your request in accordance with the Personal Data (Privacy) Ordinance.
User Consent to the Privacy Policy Statement

By downloading, registering, or browsing the "Outdoor Fit" Application, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agreed to all the terms and conditions outlined in this “Privacy Policy Statement”. If you do not accept these terms and conditions, please cease using this Application immediately.
Amendments to the Privacy Policy

This "Privacy Policy Statement" may be amended from time to time in response to system development progress or regulatory requirements. Users may review the latest version within the Application at any time. If you have any inquiries regarding our policy or data processing practices, please contact our project team prior to participating in activities.
